reference.title: Scenario: domain specialization
reference.shortdesc: A pharmaceutical company needs documentation that includes:

section.p:
A pharmaceutical company needs documentation that includes:
Clinical procedure steps with required timing windows
Regulatory compliance checkpoints
Batch lot tracking requirements
Rather than forcing these requirements into generic DITA elements, the company creates specialized elements:
section.codeblock: Administer the medication. Within 30 minutes of preparation <compliance-checkpoint ref="FDA-21CFR11"/> <batch-tracking lot-id="required"/>
section.p: These specialized elements inherit behaviours from standard DITA elements while adding domain-specific semantics. Standard DITA tools can still process the content. Domain-specific tools can enforce additional validation.
